newsitem.title: USA: PECO trims Pa. Limerick 2 nuke output--NRC.
newsitem.headline: PECO trims Pa. Limerick 2 nuke output--NRC.

text.p: PECO Energy Co trimmed power production of the 1,055 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at its Limerick nuclear generating station in Pottsdam, Pa., for repairs, a Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) spokesman said Wednesday.
"Limerick 2 reduced its power due to a valve problem at one of its turbines," the spokesman said.
Electricity output at Limerick 2 was ramped down to 40 percent from 75 percent, he said.
"They plan to go back to 75 percent," the spokesman said.
The unit has been scaling down operations ahead of a 25-day refueling outage set to begin January 31.
The nearby Limerick unit 1, also at 1,055 MW, was producing at full output.
The Limerick units are wholly-owned and operated by PECO Energy.
